review_note: 2026-10-29: reviewed physical cell-group consensus ownership at 0951440e3748da20573a6de26b7a9e97298fb385. GroupLog clones now share an exclusive consensus lease. GroupWrite retains the lease through queued physical sync/publication even when its waiter is cancelled. The CachedGroup anchor itself is unchanged and moves by three lines. The new CellGroupOwner consumes the existing verified complete root and revalidated catalog permit, persists Ready/LightReady before dependent effects, and advances complete roots only for exact contiguous entry/owner/store completions. Bounded slow-apply backpressure and cancellation/restart fixtures use real Raft Engine and SQLite/LTX. No other source anchor changed. This is the low-level shared owner, not shared SQL scheduling, SDK dispatch, snapshot/configuration/topology integration or completed CG-04 qualification. Successor 51e30eabde1ca76bf0b23963dd06d0e8130f8ee7 boxes large phase/effect payloads after all-target Clippy review and rejects exhausted peer-entry indexes before RawNode mutation. No anchored excerpt or hash changed. Reviewed successor 865f253da0a14d730b62f77b17cefc6d1497890b: the old runtime shares its unchanged terminal completion/wait behavior via a crate-private Terminal constructor with the physical cell-group node runtime; the runtime/ticks excerpts are unchanged apart from line offsets. New group runtime multiplexes owners, bounds node/group/event/completion admission, batches persistence across histories and joins physical writes before releasing runtime ownership. Reserved completion advances existing physical phases under saturated output admission. This is not per-cell SQL scheduling, receipt settlement, SDK serving or full CG-04 qualification. Reviewed successor aec4029e77124848dc6b155c098f8eec9ccdacc4: integrated main documentation consolidation and relocated the package without changing Rust behavior. Attachment now reserves ordinary request admission before catalog revalidation/RawNode construction and retains it through dispatch. The held-vote admission regression exercises the public runtime with one request slot. All anchored excerpts and hashes remain unchanged. Reviewed successor f3d48bdc86186077cff96f66597a65c2c4bd5301: added actual-leader cell execution authority with revocation on role loss, failure and owner drop. A synchronous cell SQL producer reuses the existing receipt transaction, captures either physical image kind without synthetic GroupScope, encodes cell-addressed entries and settles exact committed entry/image receipts. Shared capture and receipt helpers preserve the existing executor path. The SQL pool, registered dispatcher, coherent reads and full CG-04 gate remain unfinished. Anchored files and excerpts remain unchanged. Successor f807b2f70e01e3cd8c741557889e1965fd14ec49 removes two Clippy-rejected fixture wrappers only; runtime and assertions are unchanged.
